description:
[tourradar] Use this when the user wants to ASK A QUESTION about a tour or operator WITHOUT committing to a booking.

Two modes:
- mode "tour": a question about a specific tour. Requires `tourId`. The `departureDate` is OPTIONAL here — if the customer has not picked a date, omit it and the backend will pick the nearest real departure. Do NOT fabricate a date.
- mode "operator": a general/operator-level question. Requires `operatorId` and no tour.

Always provide the customer's real contact details (email, first/last name; phone optional) and their actual question text. Never fabricate or assume user data — ask for missing information.

agentInformation.description: Optional agent context about the customer's needs/preferences. Helps Customer Support. The customer's question stays primary; this is appended as extra context.

email.description: Customer email address. If email is not given by the customer, please ask before executing this tool. Never generate an email yourself.

entity.description: What the question is about. Pick exactly one mode: "tour" (carries `tourId` + optional departure/pax) or "operator" (carries `operatorId`). A tour question cannot carry an operator id and vice versa.

departureDate.description: Optional departure date, from the customer selection. Omit if the customer has not chosen a date — do not fabricate one; the backend will pick the nearest real departure.

mode.description: Use "tour" for a question about a specific tour.

paxAdults.description: Number of adults. Defaults to 1 when omitted.

paxChildren.description: Number of children. Defaults to 0 when omitted.

tourId.description: Tour ID. Required for a tour question.

mode.description: Use "operator" for a general/operator-level question (no specific tour).

operatorId.description: Operator ID. Required for an operator question.

phoneNumber.description: Customer phone number in E-164 format. Optional but recommended. Never put a fake phone number; if the customer does not provide one, skip this field.

question.description: The customer's actual question text. Required and must be non-empty. This is the question the customer wants answered.

name: tourradar_web-ask-question
